title: Apex Circuit
tagline: One car. One circuit. Three laps on the limit.
controls: Up / W accelerates · Down / S brakes · Left / Right steers · Touch steering and pedals

title: Burrow Rally
tagline: Drift critter karts through a three-track cup. Build boost and chase a podium finish.
controls: Arrows or A/D steer · Hold Space while turning to drift · Down brakes

title: Chess
tagline: A quiet table. A sharp opponent.
controls: Tap a piece, then its destination · Arrows + Space · AI slider above

title: Cinder Hop
tagline: A small machine for remembering. Three worlds, one ember.
controls: A/D or arrows to run · Hold Space to jump · Touch buttons below

title: Cowboys & Aliens
tagline: Hold the town. Six shots at a time.
controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim (click to lock), click to fire. Shift sprints, R reloads, F melee, E buys wall weapons and opens doors, 1-5 switches weapons. On touch: left thumb moves, drag to aim, tap to fire, walk onto drops to take them.

title: Crosstown
tagline: A city after dark. A job worth the detour.
controls: WASD / arrows drive · Space drifts · Touch steering and pedals

title: Four in a Row
tagline: Drop your discs, build threats, and connect four before your opponent.
controls: Tap to place · Arrows + Space · AI slider above the board

title: Glimmer Glide
tagline: Tiny wings. Moonlit gaps. One more flight.
controls: Tap, Space or Up to flap · P / Escape pauses

title: Goblins!
controls: Tap a card, then DRAW, TAKE, ASK, DISCARD or KNOCK. Keys: left and right pick a card; when drawing, up draws, down takes the pile, Space asks; when discarding, Space discards and up knocks.

title: Letter Leap
tagline: Type a path. Watch the traffic. Deliver the post.
controls: Type the word on a tile · Space / Enter to hop · Backspace edits · Touch letter keys work too

title: Paintball Insanity
tagline: Five rounds. The field fills up.
controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim (click to lock), click to fire. Shift sprints, C crouches (sprint + C slides), Q/E lean, R reloads, F shoves. On touch: left thumb moves, drag to aim, FIRE / R / DUCK buttons.

title: Rune Garden
tagline: Restore three enchanted gardens with clever swaps and cascading rune matches.
controls: Tap two neighboring runes · Arrows + Space also work

title: Shard Stack
tagline: Seven classic pieces. One crystal cave. Make room.
controls: Arrows move / rotate / soft-drop · Space drops · C / Shift stashes · Hold touch arrows to move

title: Tic Tac Toe
tagline: The classic three-in-a-row duel. Start easy, then try the unbeatable hard opponent.
controls: Tap to place · Arrows + Space · AI slider above the board

title: Wisp Warden
tagline: Hold back the dark, then draft a boon after every wave.
controls: Arrows / WASD, or the touch joystick, to move; your light fires by itself. Tap a card (or arrows + Space) to draft.
